description: Read Clunkyard's documentation as Markdown: the manual, the rules sheet, each language's API reference (every function's exact name, signature and meaning), the DSL references, the drones guide with its kit drones, and the MCP and local CLI guides. Without a page, lists them all. Also "game" (languages, classes and season as JSON), "rules-data" (every rule value) and "rules-changes". Long pages come in parts.

page.description: A page from the list, such as manual, rules, c, rust, zig, python, vane, drones, player-kit or mcp

since.description: rules-changes only: a snapshot version or name to compare with

name: docs
